about_the_game:
Strap in for fast, fluid, and full-throttle action in this VR arena shooter built for both casual pilots and competitive warriors. Inspired by classic boomer shooters, this first-person VR experience lets you fly with full physics-based movement, unleash powerful weapons, and dive into thrilling modes like Knockout, Team Knockout, and Capture the Flag. Whether you're looking to jump in for quick matches with bots or climb the leader boards in high-stakes showdowns, the game adapts to your pace. Explore six action-packed maps, unlock a huge range of cosmetics to suit your style, and shake things up with wild Game Mutations like bullet time, insta-knockout, Big Head, Big Gun and many more. Easy to pick up, hard to master—this is arena combat reimagined for VR.

The game is fully playable for our Early Access and packed with features, including:

  • 3 game modes: Knockout, Team Knockout, and Capture the Flag (CTF)

  • Full AI bot support, with customizable difficulty—every match can be fully populated with bots for solo or practice play

  • 14 Game Mutations that drastically alter matches and game play experiences

  • 6 diverse maps

  • A wide range of cosmetics: 50+ items to customise your look

  • 4 unique weapon types

  • Stat tracking and leader boards

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: Intel i5-4590 or AMD Ryzen 5 1500X or greater
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 970, AMD Radeon R9 290 equivalent or greater
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • VR Support: SteamVR
  • Additional Notes: VR Touch Controls
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 970, AMD Radeon R9 290 equivalent or greater
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • VR Support: SteamVR
  • Additional Notes: VR Touch Controls

short_description: A fast-paced VR arena shooter with full flight, boomer shooter action, and physics-driven movement. Jump into solo or competitive play with bots or friends, unlock cosmetics, and shake up matches with wild Game Mutations. Easy to pick up, hard to master.
